findings.motion: HB 1339 Voter identification, authored by Representative Campbell, first reading and referral to Committee on Elections and Apportionment
findings.note: She authored HB 1339, with two co-authors. The summary says: Provides that a REAL ID driver's license or identification card that complies with certain requirements is sufficient proof of identification for purposes of elections statutes. The page shows no action after referral to committee on 2026-01-06 and no roll call votes. This is a secondary tracking site, not the legislature's own page.
